about.body: The AJ20 is a 2.0-litre inline-four diesel engine sourced from Ford's Duratorq / Puma family, fitted to the Jaguar X-Type (X400) from 2003 to 2009. It's one of the diesel options in the X-Type range, alongside the later ZSD-420 2.2-litre diesel and the petrol V6 options. The engine is based on Ford's Puma architecture, a widely-used diesel platform that appeared across multiple Ford, Mazda, and PSA vehicles during this period.

byModel.body: The AJ20 was fitted exclusively to the X-Type in the UK market, specifically in the 2.0D variant (X400 generation, 2003-2009). It served as the entry-level diesel option in the X-Type range, offering a balance of fuel economy and performance that suited the saloon and estate body styles.
